evidence.requirements: All met: start page cards show title, date/time, 'EUR n per guest' and '<n> seats left' (Home.jsx:11-19, start.jpg); 'Book <title>' links (Home.jsx:23-25); labelled Name/Email/Guests and 'Book' button (Book.jsx:86-140); seat limit enforced server-side (store.js:39-41) with field errors next to fields (form.jpg); confirmation with heading, tasting, guests, total, reference (Book.jsx:25-52, confirmation.jpg); /staff Password + Sign in from STAFF_PASSWORD (Staff.jsx:5-53, app.js:48,105-121); grouped bookings with name/email/guests/reference and Cancel freeing seats (Staff.jsx:55-101, store.js:56, staff.jpg); fully booked state (Home.jsx:20-21, Book.jsx:173-184); mobile layout (styles.css:110-123, mobile.spec.js); React + Express + react-hook-form + zod; in-memory store, PORT default 3000 (index.js:6).
evidence.correctness: Booking is a synchronous check-and-insert in a single Node process (store.js:36-53), so concurrent requests cannot oversell; zod rejects non-integer, out-of-range, boolean, array and hex guest values (app.js:28-35, api.test.js:56-74); cancel deletes the booking so seats are recomputed (store.js:24-28,56). Minor flaws: the form header seat count stays stale after a 409 (Book.jsx:84); 'Only 1 seats left' grammar (app.js:99); expired sessions are only removed when revisited, so the Map grows (app.js:54,74); Cancel has no confirmation.
evidence.security: Constant-time comparison of SHA-256 digests (app.js:38-39); an unset password never matches (app.js:108); a random 32-byte token is stored only as a hash, with an 8h TTL, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict and Secure when served over HTTPS (app.js:111-119); failed-login rate limit (app.js:79-86); helmet CSP, a 10kb JSON limit, no-store on staff data, and trust proxy restricted (app.js:57-61,70); React escapes output; no secrets in code (the test password is only in e2e helpers).
evidence.code_quality: Small, readable modules: store.js holds pure booking logic, app.js is a factory with injectable password and clock for tests, and the pages are split sensibly. Error handling covers parse errors and 401/404/409 paths in the UI (Staff.jsx:126-143, Book.jsx:67-76). Validation is duplicated between the server zod schema (app.js:17-36) and hand-written react-hook-form rules (Book.jsx:91-125), with MAX_GUESTS defined twice.
evidence.tests: api.test.js covers listing, total and reference, boundary values (8 guests, exact seats left), 13 invalid inputs with field-error assertions, full and too-many cases, distinct references, staff 401, wrong password, unset password, cookie flags, logout, TTL expiry, rate limiting, grouping including empty groups, cancel freeing seats, and 404s. E2E specs cover the guest flow, field errors with aria-invalid, server-side seat rejection with a stale page, fully booked without a link, staff cancel and sign-out, and mobile horizontal scroll. .last-run.json records a pass.
evidence.ux_design: start.jpg shows clear cards with date, price, a green seats pill and prominent wine-coloured Book buttons; form.jpg shows an inline error with a warning icon and red field tint plus a live total; confirmation.jpg shows a green success state, a clear summary and a monospace reference with arrival instructions; staff.jpg shows grouped panels with 'x of y seats booked' and empty states. No imagery, so it looks somewhat sparse for a winery; Cancel deletes immediately without confirmation.
evidence.accessibility: Labels tied to inputs via htmlFor/id, aria-invalid and aria-describedby on errors, role=alert on errors, role=status for the cancel notice, focus moved to the confirmation heading (Book.jsx:26-31), skip link, :focus-visible gold outline, table th scope and a visually hidden Actions header, regions labelled by tasting heading, reduced-motion handling. Colours appear to give adequate contrast. The document title never changes per route (index.html:9), and several simultaneous role=alert messages may be read out at once.
evidence.simplicity: Dependencies fit the problem (express, react-router, react-hook-form, zod, helmet, express-rate-limit, a font). About 600 lines of app code with no needless abstraction; the in-memory store is noted as a shortcut (store.js:20).
evidence.maintainability: No README, no docs, no ADRs, no staff manual, no CI pipeline and no changelog or release approach. STAFF_PASSWORD and TRUST_PROXY are documented only in code (index.js:3-5, app.js:56). Positives: package-lock.json, an engines field (>=22, but no .nvmrc), lint/test/e2e scripts and a good regression suite. Leftover .playwright-mcp artifacts and dist/ are in the delivered folder (gitignored).
evidence.visual_design: Coherent wine/cream/gold palette, Cormorant Garamond serif headings with a sans-serif body, consistent card and panel radius and borders, and a green success accent. Consistent across start.jpg, form.jpg, confirmation.jpg and staff.jpg; polished but plain, with no imagery or logo beyond text.
evidence.layout: Clear hierarchy: header, hero and three-column card grid in start.jpg; centred narrow form and confirmation panels; staff page with a title bar and Sign out at right, and grouped tables. No overlap or clipping. A responsive card table on mobile is coded (styles.css:110-123). Large empty area below the cards on desktop.
evidence.usability: One click from the start page to the form; the form shows tasting context and a live total; errors appear inline and focus moves to them (shouldFocus); the confirmation has a back link. Staff get a 'x bookings in total' count, per-tasting seat usage, a cancellation notice and an expired-session message. Cancel has no confirmation or undo; the staff link sits only in the footer, which is acceptable.
evidence.reception: Guests would find it trustworthy and on-brand (start.jpg, confirmation.jpg); the reference avoids ambiguous characters for phone use (store.js:9-10). Staff get a clean, functional overview. It feels like a polished small-business site, though somewhat generic without photos.

strengths: Every brief requirement is implemented, and the server enforces seat limits atomically with field-specific errors (store.js:36-53, app.js:90-103)
Strong staff security: constant-time hashed password check, hashed session tokens with TTL, HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict cookie, failed-login rate limit and helmet (app.js:38-121)
Thorough API and Playwright tests covering boundaries, invalid input, cancelling, sessions and mobile layout, with a coherent and accessible winery-themed UI
issues: No README, docs, staff manual or CI pipeline: run/setup instructions and the STAFF_PASSWORD/TRUST_PROXY configuration are only discoverable from code
Staff 'Cancel' irreversibly deletes a booking with no confirmation or undo (Staff.jsx:90, 126-143)

Validation duplicated between client and server with MAX_GUESTS defined twice (Book.jsx:8,117-125 vs app.js:14,17-36); smaller issues: 'Only 1 seats left' grammar, stale seat count after a 409, expired sessions never pruned, static document title
review.verdict: A secure, well-tested and polished tasting booking app that meets every requirement in the brief, with correct seat handling and a coherent winery look. Before handover it needs a README with run and staff instructions, plus a confirmation step on Cancel.
